blocks.content: Soil is a dynamic natural body formed by the interaction of climate, organisms, relief, parent material, and time.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Hans Jenny formulated the soil formation equation S = f(Cl, o, r, p, t) in 1941.
Climate and Organisms are active factors that directly supply energy and matter to drive soil processes.
Parent Material, Relief, and Time act as passive factors determining background conditions and initial substrate.
Steep relief leads to thin soil layers due to erosion, whereas flat topography allows thick soil horizon development.
Time determines soil maturity, with older soils exhibiting well-defined horizons compared to young alluvial soils.

rows: Actively supply energy, moisture, and biological activity to transform soil
Provide original material, condition moisture/drainage, and give duration for soil profile maturity

items: Questions often ask to categorize factors into Active (Climate, Organisms) versus Passive (Relief, Parent Material, Time).
Black soil (Regur) is a classic exam example where Parent Material (basalt rock) dictates soil characteristics.
Hans Jenny is credited with defining the CLORPT formula in 1941.
